comment.text: UCHL1 H161 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Cutaneous melanoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting UCHL1 residue H161 have been observed in cutaneous melanoma.
